description:
Functional specifications/files: ServerManager, Factory, ProviderSpec and Connect resolver; synchronously resolve once from trusted effective Actor, build one runtime config, track credential/person/grant/expiry without secrets, no legacy/global fallback or warm-path resolution.
Tests first: Actor/policy matrix integration, Person isolation, one resolver call, startup errors, zero warm-path resolution.
Branches: Person/global grant, required/optional/disabled, missing/invalid/expired grants, unsupported auth.
Mocking: real Connect boundaries; injected edge OAuth client/timeouts only.
Docs: Agent and Engine service contracts.
Action reuse: reuse Connect.resolve_credential, Factory runtime_config, ProviderSpec translation, ServerManager lifecycle; extend these owners, no Action/tool exposure.
title: [zaq-jrg] Resolve Person authentication during Agent startup
